name: OpenSea
description: The largest NFT marketplace has not released a token yet. Active traders may qualify for a future airdrop.
requirements: Buy or sell NFTs on OpenSea
Maintain trading volume over multiple months
Use OpenSea Pro for advanced trading

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet
steps.description: Visit OpenSea and connect MetaMask or another Web3 wallet. Make sure you have some ETH for gas and purchases.

steps.title: Make Your First Trade
steps.description: Buy an affordable NFT from a collection you like. Even small purchases count toward activity.

steps.title: Use OpenSea Pro
steps.description: OpenSea Pro is their advanced aggregator. Using it may signal deeper engagement.

steps.title: Trade Regularly
steps.description: Maintain consistent activity over time. List, buy, and sell across different collections.
steps.tips: Genuine trading activity is more valuable than one-time large purchases.

risks: No confirmed airdrop - based on speculation
NFT prices are volatile - you may lose money on trades
Gas fees on Ethereum can be high
Marketplace fees apply to each trade

name: Blur
description: Blur is a pro NFT marketplace with ongoing seasonal reward programs. Trading and bidding earn points toward token rewards.
requirements: Maintain loyalty by trading exclusively on Blur

steps.title: Connect to Blur
steps.description: Visit Blur.io and connect your wallet. Blur is designed for professional NFT traders.

steps.title: Place Bids
steps.description: Bidding on collections earns the most points. Place competitive bids on blue-chip collections.
steps.tips: Bidding loyalty (only bidding on Blur) maximizes points.

steps.title: Trade Actively
steps.description: Buy and sell NFTs. Trading volume contributes to your reward tier.

steps.title: Track Your Points
steps.description: Check your points and reward tier in the Blur dashboard regularly.

risks: NFT floor prices can drop suddenly
Points system rules change between seasons
High competition for top reward tiers

name: Magic Eden
description: Multi-chain NFT marketplace popular on Solana. Diamond rewards program gives points for trading activity.
requirements: Trade across multiple chains (Solana, Ethereum, Bitcoin)

steps.title: Set Up a Solana Wallet
steps.description: Install Phantom or another Solana wallet. Magic Eden is strongest on Solana with low fees.

steps.title: Connect to Magic Eden
steps.description: Visit Magic Eden and connect your wallet.

steps.title: Earn Diamonds
steps.description: Trade NFTs to earn Diamonds. Low Solana fees make frequent trading affordable.

steps.title: Complete Quests
steps.description: Check for daily and weekly quests that give bonus Diamonds.
steps.tips: Solana's low fees make Magic Eden ideal for high-frequency activity.

name: Tensor
description: Pro NFT marketplace on Solana. TNSR token holders and active traders earn ongoing rewards.

steps.title: Connect a Solana Wallet
steps.description: Use Phantom or Solflare wallet to connect to Tensor.

steps.title: Trade NFTs
steps.description: Tensor is built for speed and pro traders. Buy and sell to accumulate points.

steps.title: Provide Pool Liquidity
steps.description: Advanced users can provide liquidity to NFT AMM pools for extra rewards.
steps.tips: Liquidity provision carries impermanent loss risk for NFTs.

risks: NFT AMM liquidity can suffer losses
